svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two from 10 mm plate (waterjet or saw and file); lengths from the back edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Profile: 404 long; 130 wide for the first 60 mm,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tapering to 100 wide at 259 mm, ending in a 55 mm radius round the pivot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pivot bore 45.4 mm, 349 mm from the back edge, on the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 18 mm holes for the adapter screws, 15 and 45 mm from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: back edge, 50 mm each side of the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Window 30 mm wide from 80 to 234 mm from the back edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upper plate only: two 13.6 mm handle holes on the centre line at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 69 and 199 mm from the back edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bore the two pivot holes with the plates clamped together.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr; round the outside corners about 3 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a 45 mm pin goes through both pivot bores clamped together.
